title: Music cue
description: films/<film>/audio/music/<cue_id>.json: how <cue_id>.wav was made (D-036). The director asks for a mood, an energy and optional instruments; code writes the model caption. Instrumental only in v1. The seed makes a cue reproducible.

cue_id.description: Referenced by a shot's music_cue, e.g. 'm01'.

mood.description: One of the moods compose knows (task 3.4), e.g. 'playful'.

caption.description: The exact text given to the music model (written by code).

looped.description: True if a shorter generation was looped to reach duration_s.

hash.description: sha256 of the request (mood, energy, instruments, duration, model, seed).
